title: Selecting matching junta examples
statement: Let $n$, $M$, and $R$ be natural numbers, let $P$ be a finite set of coordinates in $\\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $z$ assign a sign to each coordinate in $P$. Given a sequence of $R$ labeled samples from $\{\pm1\}^n$, the construction returns a tuple of $M$ samples that match $z$ on $P$ if at least $M$ samples in the sequence match; otherwise, it returns no tuple.
